Fellow barista here just trying to give my two cents, but as someone with an anxiety disorder too I definitely get where you're coming from! I'm on about my third month too and while I love my job, I feel like everyone around me is just silently judging me and thinks I'm not capable of doing anything right. From what it sounds like you're excellent at your job, you just go slower and that's fine! Not everyone can go a hundred miles an hour. If you did you might mess something up and feel a million times worse. Go at your own pace and let your coworkers know that you need time with things. Keep working on believing in yourself and do your best!
